svg.aria-label: Beta run flowchart for a single channel. Steps down the left column: params, LoadCSC, a skipped and bypassed FindIEDs box, MakeEpochs, FilterBanks, ModIndexFast, CFC with surrogates off, CFC with 100 surrogates, ThetaPower, ChannelQC and SaveChannel, and finally looking at the result. Each step is paired with a numbered gate in the right column giving the pass criterion and what a failure means. Runtimes are marked on each step and total about thirty minutes for one thirty-minute recording.
svg.text: every setting in one place: epochSec=6, nbin=18, nSurr=100,
read_csc(ncsPath,10) -> 3255 Hz · notch · gap + clip check
one channel, one 30-min recording, nothing else
10 s of trace shows theta by eye; spectrum is 1/f, no 60 Hz
FAILS IF: wrong downsample, dead channel, notch off.
the windows of interest carry no IEDs, and leaving transients in is
informative. Record, do not remove: see the epoch table below.
floor(T/6) = 300 blocks, no overlap, nothing dropped
columns: idx t0 t1 i0 i1 maxAbs nSharp (recorded, never used to drop)
nEp == floor(T/6). First and last epoch sit inside the
filter-safe margin. maxAbs and nSharp filled for every one.
FAILS IF: off-by-one at the edges — Output C breaks silently.
the two parfor loops from newFCSE.m, on the WHOLE trace
-> Phase [17 x T] and Amp [37 x T] (1.5 GB in double — use single)
Plot one fast envelope over one slow band for 2 s. It should
visibly rise and fall with the slow cycle.
If nothing tracks anything, check the fast bandwidth before
blaming biology: 10 Hz at 80 Hz cannot carry 8 Hz modulation.
same arithmetic as ModIndex_v2, bin index computed once per epoch
returns all 37 fast bands per pass, not 37 x 18 find() calls
ModIndex_v2.m stays in the repo, unchanged, as the reference
Without it the surrogates cost 5 h 23 m instead of 25 min.
FAILS IF: bin edges differ — check the half-open interval.
mean(MI,3) should put the blob where newFCSE.m puts it for
this channel. Values differ (6 s is more biased); the
LOCATION must not. FAILS IF: the blob moves. Stop if it does.
circular shift of Amp against Phase, inside each epoch
100 shifts x 188,700 cells, blocked so all 37 fast bands go at once
Re-run on a phase-shuffled copy of the same channel.
Every z should sit near zero — |z| < 3, no structure anywhere.
The most valuable check in the beta run: a broken surrogate
mean |Phase-bank envelope|^2 per epoch, 17 slow bands
reuses the bank from FilterBanks.m — no new filtering
Power and MI share an index
size(P,2) == size(MI,3) == height(ep). Peak theta lands in a
band you believe for this layer. Plot P and MI over time.
FAILS IF: off by one — Output C is then quietly wrong.
7-panel PNG, with the raw trace UNDER the MI-over-time trace
